predicate.name: Is canonical regime
predicate.description: Marks a Regime as canonical; every declared Regime satisfies it.

predicate.name: Requirement satisfied
predicate.description: Minimal requirement-satisfaction predicate used by the theory interface.

predicate.name: Profile well formed
predicate.description: A regime profile is well formed when its regime is canonical.

predicate.name: Under split pressure
predicate.description: Holds when the canonical axes record a split-forcing transformation.

predicate.name: Regime application admissible
predicate.description: A regime application is admissible when the substrate element is neutral relative to the consequence system and framework.

predicate.name: Non-collapsing
predicate.description: Two regimes are non-collapsing when some transformation receives different classification values.

predicate.name: Graph well formed
predicate.description: Every vertex in the graph carries a canonical regime.
